title: Refund Timeline
content: Refunds for returned items are processed within 5-7 business days after the item is received at the warehouse. If the amount is not credited within this window, the customer should raise a dispute.

metadata.trigger: customer returned an item and is waiting for the refund
metadata.not_for: money deducted on a failed or not-placed order (see DOC-2)

title: Failed Payment - Amount Deducted
content: If an amount is deducted during checkout but the order shows as failed/not placed, the amount is auto-reversed within 24-48 hours under the payment gateway's standard TAT. No customer action is needed before 48 hours.

metadata.trigger: money was debited but the order failed or was never placed

title: Dispute Resolution Process
content: A dispute can be raised via the app or customer care. Disputes are resolved within 7-10 working days as per the company's dispute resolution policy.

metadata.trigger: a refund or reversal has not arrived within its stated window

title: Account Password Reset
content: Account passwords can be reset via the app using registered email or phone-based OTP. Support cannot reset a password directly for security reasons.

metadata.trigger: customer cannot log in or wants a password changed

title: Order Value Limits
content: Default single-order limit is Rs 1,00,000, with a daily cap of Rs 1,00,000 across orders, unless the customer has an enhanced limit enabled on their account.

metadata.trigger: maximum order amount or daily spending cap

title: International Shipping Returns
content: International orders (where supported) can take 2-3 additional business days beyond domestic return timelines due to cross-border logistics.

window.starts_at: added to the domestic refund window

metadata.trigger: refund or return timeline for an international order

title: Chargeback vs Return Dispute
content: A chargeback applies to direct card-issuer disputes; orders placed through the platform use the platform's own dispute mechanism, not chargebacks. Support should not use the term 'chargeback' for platform order issues.

metadata.trigger: customer asks for a chargeback on a platform order

title: Escalation Matrix
content: If a dispute is not resolved within the stated window, it can be escalated to the platform's grievance officer after the standard internal resolution process has been exhausted.

metadata.trigger: an existing dispute is past its resolution window
